core_obligations: Reduce to a final object (proof lines 11184-11186): replacing C by C/U one may assume U = X is a final object.
Use the structure of quasi-coherent objects there (proof lines 11187-11188): the final-object lemma gives K = Lf^*P with P = R Gamma(U, K) = Rf_*K.
Conclude by adjunction (proof lines 11189-11190): since Lf^* is left adjoint to Rf_* = R Gamma(U, -), the two Hom groups are identified, which is the assertion.
proof_roadmap: Localise at U so that U is a final object.
Write the quasi-coherent object as the pullback of its global sections.
Apply the adjunction between the pullback and the derived global sections.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes maps out of a quasi-coherent object over any object of the site as the derived Hom of the global sections groups (statement lines 11172-11181). The proof (proof lines 11183-11190) localises to a final object, uses the description of quasi-coherent objects there as pullbacks of their global sections, and applies the adjunction between the pullback and the derived global sections. H2: one localisation and one adjunction.
